"""Patch a copy of python312.dll so a chosen exported function spins forever (EB FE),
run app.exe, then suspend the process, read RCX/RDX at the hang point and dump memory.

Usage: python hookdump.py <dir> <funcname> [outprefix]
All paths are normalized and constrained under ROOT (g5-a).
Writes: <outprefix>.ss / <outprefix>.marshal.tidN / <outprefix>.meta
"""
import sys, os, struct, ctypes, ctypes.wintypes as wt, subprocess, time, json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(r"<G5A_WORKDIR>").resolve()

def safe(p) -> Path:
    rp = Path(p).resolve()
    if rp != ROOT and ROOT not in rp.parents:
        raise ValueError(f"path outside ROOT: {rp}")
    return rp

def save_bytes(p: Path, data: bytes):
    rp = safe(p)
    rp.write_bytes(data)

def save_text(p: Path, text: str):
    rp = safe(p)
    rp.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

# ---------- PE export table ----------
def load_pe(d):
    e = struct.unpack_from('<I', d, 0x3c)[0]
    coff = e + 4
    nsec = struct.unpack_from('<H', d, coff + 2)[0]
    optsz = struct.unpack_from('<H', d, coff + 16)[0]
    opt = coff + 20
    magic = struct.unpack_from('<H', d, opt)[0]
    assert magic == 0x20b
    imgbase = struct.unpack_from('<Q', d, opt + 24)[0]
    secs = []
    so = opt + optsz
    for i in range(nsec):
        vsize, vaddr, rsize, raddr = struct.unpack_from('<IIII', d, so + i*40 + 8)
        secs.append((vaddr, max(vsize, rsize), raddr, rsize))
    exp_rva, exp_size = struct.unpack_from('<II', d, opt + 112)
    return d, secs, imgbase, exp_rva, exp_size

def rva2off(secs, rva):
    for vaddr, vsz, raddr, rsz in secs:
        if vaddr <= rva < vaddr + vsz:
            return raddr + (rva - vaddr)
    return None

def get_exports(d, secs, exp_rva, exp_size):
    o = rva2off(secs, exp_rva)
    nnames = struct.unpack_from('<I', d, o+24)[0]
    names_rva = struct.unpack_from('<I', d, o+32)[0]
    eas_rva = struct.unpack_from('<I', d, o+36)[0]
    funcs_rva = struct.unpack_from('<I', d, o+28)[0]
    exports = {}
    eo = rva2off(secs, names_rva)
    eao = rva2off(secs, eas_rva)
    fo = rva2off(secs, funcs_rva)
    for i in range(nnames):
        nrva = struct.unpack_from('<I', d, eo + 4*i)[0]
        no = rva2off(secs, nrva)
        end = d.index(b'\0', no)
        name = d[no:end].decode()
        ordinal = struct.unpack_from('<H', d, eao + 2*i)[0]
        frva = struct.unpack_from('<I', d, fo + 4*ordinal)[0]
        exports[name] = frva
    return exports

def patch_dll(dllpath: Path, funcname):
    d = dllpath.read_bytes()
    d, secs, imgbase, exp_rva, exp_size = load_pe(d)
    exports = get_exports(d, secs, exp_rva, exp_size)
    rva = exports[funcname]
    off = rva2off(secs, rva)
    if d[off:off+2] == b'\xeb\xfe':
        print(f"[patch] {funcname} already patched at rva={rva:#x}")
        return rva
    d = d[:off] + b'\xeb\xfe' + d[off+2:]
    save_bytes(dllpath, d)
    print(f"[patch] {funcname} rva={rva:#x} fileoff={off:#x} -> EB FE")
    return rva

# ---------- WinAPI process tools ----------
k32 = ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32', use_last_error=True)
PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS = 0x1F0FFF
TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD = 0x4
class THREADENTRY32(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('dwSize', wt.DWORD), ('cntUsage', wt.DWORD), ('th32ThreadID', wt.DWORD),
                ('th32OwnerProcessID', wt.DWORD), ('tpBasePri', ctypes.c_long), ('tpDeltaPri', ctypes.c_long), ('dwFlags', wt.DWORD)]
class CONTEXT(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('P1Home', ctypes.c_uint64), ('P2Home', ctypes.c_uint64), ('P3Home', ctypes.c_uint64), ('P4Home', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('P5Home', ctypes.c_uint64), ('P6Home', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('ContextFlags', wt.DWORD), ('MxCsr', wt.DWORD),
                ('SegCs', wt.WORD), ('SegDs', wt.WORD), ('SegEs', wt.WORD), ('SegFs', wt.WORD),
                ('SegGs', wt.WORD), ('SegSs', wt.WORD), ('EFlags', wt.DWORD),
                ('Dr0', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Dr1', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Dr2', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Dr3', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('Dr6', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Dr7', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('Rax', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Rcx', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Rdx', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Rbx', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('Rsp', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Rbp', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Rsi', ctypes.c_uint64), ('Rdi', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('R8', ctypes.c_uint64), ('R9', ctypes.c_uint64), ('R10', ctypes.c_uint64), ('R11', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('R12', ctypes.c_uint64), ('R13', ctypes.c_uint64), ('R14', ctypes.c_uint64), ('R15', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('Rip', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('FltSave', ctypes.c_byte * 512), ('VectorRegister', ctypes.c_byte * 26*16),
                ('DebugControl', ctypes.c_uint64), ('LastBranchToRip', ctypes.c_uint64), ('LastBranchFromRip', ctypes.c_uint64),
                ('LastExceptionToRip', ctypes.c_uint64), ('LastExceptionFromRip', ctypes.c_uint64)]

def threads_of(pid):
    snap = k32.CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD, 0)
    te = THREADENTRY32(); te.dwSize = ctypes.sizeof(te)
    out = []
    ok = k32.Thread32First(snap, ctypes.byref(te))
    while ok:
        if te.th32OwnerProcessID == pid:
            out.append(te.th32ThreadID)
        ok = k32.Thread32Next(snap, ctypes.byref(te))
    k32.CloseHandle(snap)
    return out

TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS = 0x2
TH32CS_SNAPMODULE = 0x8
class PROCESSENTRY32W(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('dwSize', wt.DWORD), ('cntUsage', wt.DWORD), ('th32ProcessID', wt.DWORD),
                ('th32DefaultHeapID', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_ulong)), ('th32ModuleID', wt.DWORD),
                ('cntThreads', wt.DWORD), ('th32ParentProcessID', wt.DWORD), ('pcPriClassBase', ctypes.c_long),
                ('dwFlags', wt.DWORD), ('szExeFile', wt.WCHAR * 260)]
class MODULEENTRY32W(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('dwSize', wt.DWORD), ('th32ModuleID', wt.DWORD), ('th32ProcessID', wt.DWORD),
                ('GlblcntUsage', wt.DWORD), ('ProccntUsage', wt.DWORD), ('modBaseAddr', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_byte)),
                ('modBaseSize', wt.DWORD), ('hModule', ctypes.c_void_p), ('szModule', wt.WCHAR * 256),
                ('szExePath', wt.WCHAR * 260)]

def find_processes_by_name(name):
    snap = k32.CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0)
    pe = PROCESSENTRY32W(); pe.dwSize = ctypes.sizeof(pe)
    out = []
    ok = k32.Process32FirstW(snap, ctypes.byref(pe))
    while ok:
        if pe.szExeFile.lower() == name.lower():
            out.append((pe.th32ProcessID, pe.th32ParentProcessID))
        ok = k32.Process32NextW(snap, ctypes.byref(pe))
    k32.CloseHandle(snap)
    return out

def module_base(pid, modname):
    snap = k32.CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPMODULE, pid)
    if snap is None or snap == ctypes.c_void_p(-1).value or snap == -1:
        return None
    me = MODULEENTRY32W(); me.dwSize = ctypes.sizeof(me)
    ok = k32.Module32FirstW(snap, ctypes.byref(me))
    res = None
    while ok:
        if me.szModule.lower() == modname.lower():
            res = ctypes.cast(me.modBaseAddr, ctypes.c_void_p).value
            break
        ok = k32.Module32NextW(snap, ctypes.byref(me))
    k32.CloseHandle(snap)
    return res

def read_mem(hp, addr, size):
    buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(size)
    got = ctypes.c_size_t(0)
    r = k32.ReadProcessMemory(hp, ctypes.c_void_p(addr), buf, size, ctypes.byref(got))
    if not r:
        return None
    return buf.raw[:got.value]

def main():
    wdir = safe(sys.argv[1])
    func = sys.argv[2]
    prefix = safe(wdir / Path(sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 'hook').name)
    origdll = safe(Path(sys.argv[4])) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else None
    dll = safe(wdir / 'python312.dll')
    if origdll is not None:
        save_bytes(dll, origdll.read_bytes())
        print(f"[restore] pristine dll from {origdll.name}")
    patch_dll(dll, func)
    p = subprocess.Popen([str(safe(wdir / 'app.exe'))], cwd=str(wdir),
                         stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    time.sleep(1.5)
    if p.poll() is not None:
        out, err = p.communicate()
        print(f"[!] process exited early rc={p.returncode} out={out[:200]!r} err={err[:500]!r}")
        return
    try:
        p.stdin.write(b'hello\n')
        p.stdin.flush()
    except Exception as e:
        print('[!] stdin write failed:', e)
    time.sleep(1.5)
    pid = p.pid
    time.sleep(1.0)
    procs = find_processes_by_name('app.exe')
    print(f"[procs] app.exe processes: {procs} (spawned pid={pid})")
    patch_rva = None
    d = dll.read_bytes()
    d, secs, imgbase, exp_rva, exp_size = load_pe(d)
    patch_rva = get_exports(d, secs, exp_rva, exp_size)[func]
    meta = {}
    dumped = 0
    for cpid, cppid in procs:
        base = module_base(cpid, 'python312.dll')
        if not base:
            print(f"pid={cpid} no python312.dll module visible")
            continue
        patchva = base + patch_rva
        hp = k32.OpenProcess(PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS, False, cpid)
        if not hp:
            print(f"pid={cpid} OpenProcess failed err={ctypes.GetLastError()}")
            continue
        for tid in threads_of(cpid):
            th = k32.OpenThread(0x1FFFFF, False, tid)
            k32.SuspendThread(th)
            ctx = CONTEXT(); ctx.ContextFlags = 0x100003
            r = k32.GetThreadContext(th, ctypes.byref(ctx))
            at_hook = (r and ctx.Rip == patchva)
            print(f"pid={cpid} tid={tid} rip={ctx.Rip:#x} patchva={patchva:#x} at_hook={bool(at_hook)} rcx={ctx.Rcx:#x} rdx={ctx.Rdx:#x}")
            if at_hook:
                rcx, rdx = ctx.Rcx, ctypes.c_ssize_t(ctx.Rdx).value
                meta[f'{cpid}:{tid}'] = dict(rip=ctx.Rip, rcx=rcx, rdx=rdx, base=base)
                if func == 'PyRun_SimpleString':
                    blob = read_mem(hp, rcx, 1 << 20)
                    if blob and 0 in blob[:1 << 20]:
                        s = blob[:blob.index(0)]
                        save_bytes(prefix.with_name(prefix.name + '.ss'), s)
                        print(f"[dump] PyRun_SimpleString len={len(s)}")
                        dumped += 1
                else:
                    if 0 < rdx < 50_000_000:
                        blob = read_mem(hp, rcx, rdx)
                        if blob:
                            fn = prefix.with_name(prefix.name + f'.marshal.p{cpid}')
                            save_bytes(fn, blob)
                            print(f"[dump] pid={cpid} len={rdx} -> {fn.name}")
                            dumped += 1
            k32.CloseHandle(th)  # leaves thread suspended
        k32.TerminateProcess(hp, 1)
        k32.CloseHandle(hp)
    save_text(prefix.with_name(prefix.name + '.meta'), json.dumps(meta, indent=1))
    print(f"[done] hook hits dumped: {dumped}")
    try:
        p.kill()
    except Exception:
        pass

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
